mostWorthwhile.text: Catching and sweeping particles was most worthwhile: the sequence showed how sticky mucus and moving hairs work together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the defenses to the body was the least engaging part; it was the only gameplay action offered and mostly brought together things already shown.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a lung white blood cell could surround a bacterium and break it apart inside itself.

arbitrary.text: Combining the two defenses before attaching them to the body felt a little like an assembly step, though the cutaway gave it a purpose by showing their different locations.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: seeing two defenses work in different places was clear and interesting, though the final assembly was predictable.
